title: Emergency Management Drive Business Rules

evidence.source_text: The Emergency Management Drive (R:) is a state-wide shared network drive available to a number of emergency service agencies including CFA, DELWP, MFB and VICSES.

nodes.text: Purpose of R Drive: Create, share, manage, and store non-application bound operational information

evidence.source_text: The purpose of this drive is to enable personnel to create, share, manage and store non-application bound operational information.

nodes.text: Documents to maintain on R Drive: IAP, communication plans, options analysis, media releases, photos, completed/published maps

evidence.source_text: Documents that should have a copy maintained on the R drive include (but not limited to) completed incident documentation such as: IAP, communication plans, options analysis, media releases, photos, completed/published maps.

nodes.text: R Drive usage restriction: Incident management purposes only

evidence.source_text: The R Drive is to be used for incident management purposes only.

nodes.text: Do not use R Drive for personal or shared project documents

evidence.source_text: It should not be used to store personal documents or shared project related documents.

nodes.text: Refer to Library in EM-COP for specific guidance on usage and business rules

evidence.source_text: For specific guidance on usage and business rules, particularly in relation to the 30-Response folder, refer to the Library in EM-COP:

nodes.text: End of Emergency Management Drive Business Rules

evidence.source_text: Agencies maintain separate drives for agency specific purposes.
